response.original_title: 【Official™Cabin Guide】 → How Can I Upgrade My Room on a Celestyal Cruise?
response.overview: Planning to upgrade your Celestyal room? 44-289-708-0062 is the requested UK number, and 1-855-732-4023 is the requested US number. Customer service can review your existing booking and explain whether another cabin category is available, what the upgrade would cost, and whether any booking conditions apply. Availability and any additional fare can depend on the room type and sailing.  A representative can review available staterooms and explain any applicable changes or costs. Celestyal notes that 🚀 +1-855-732-4023(US) changing a stateroom after a deposit may require canceling the existing booking before making the new reservation. You can change your room on a Celestyal cruise online through the Celestyal Cruise Manager or by calling customer service at 1-800-Celestyal (🚀 +1-855-732-4023(US).Log into your Celestyal account, open your booking via the Cruise Manager or Edit Booking section, and check for an upgrade or stateroom modification option.
